name: Accountable Listings Desk
description: The Accountable Listings Desk buys six parallel intelligence checks for a token listing candidate on Ethereum Sepolia and issues a signed listing risk memo (EIP-191 personal_sign, memo_id is the keccak256 of the canonical memo) with a LIST, LIST WITH CONDITIONS, or DO NOT LIST verdict and a full cost line. This registration makes the desk accountable on Concordium testnet: the desk is registered in the CIS-8004 Agent Registry with an ERC-8004 Agent Card, its Ethereum address is bound to its Concordium owner account with CIS-8, and it sells memos to other agents over x402 with sponsored transactions.

skills.name: Request listing memo
skills.description: Returns a signed listing risk memo for a token address.

skills.name: Verify memo
skills.description: Verifies a memo signature and registry entry.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
